text: Good evening. I am the grandfather of a 2 year old boy, he is staying with us tonight. Fever since yesterday, just now it is 39.5. He has got some small dark red-purple dots on his tummy and legs, I pressed the side of a tumbler on them like they say and they are not going, they are still showing through the glass. Also his crying is not his normal crying, it is quite weak and high, sort of thin, and it is going on and on, I think. Please tell me straight how much paracetamol or ibuprofen I can give him for this age, and which one is better. Kindly reply soon.
